user.suspendBody: They will be logged out everywhere and cannot log in until you reactivate the account.
user.reasonHelp: Kept in the audit log. For example: Posted fake jobs asking for fees.
user.adminNote: Admin accounts cannot be suspended here.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.removeBody: Workers will no longer see this job. The employer sees your reason.
jobs.reasonHelp: For example: Asks workers to pay a registration fee.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every change an admin makes, newest first.
audit.emptyBody: Suspensions and removed jobs will be listed here.
audit.errorTitle: We could not load the audit log

actions.notification_released: Delivered an alert that was blocked as spam
actions.notification_priority_corrected: Corrected the priority of an alert

overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: How notifications are doing right now. This page updates itself every 30 seconds.
overview.errorTitle: We could not load the overview

rates.title: Messages that got through
rates.help: Each message counts once: if a retry got it through, it counts as a success.

queues.title: Waiting in the queues
queues.help: “Planned for later” is normal: retries, urgent safety-net checks and quiet hours.
queues.error: We could not read the queues. Check that Redis is running.

failures.title: Latest failed deliveries
failures.none: No failed deliveries in the last 24 hours.

logs.title: Delivery logs
logs.intro: Every try to send an alert, newest first. One alert can have several tries.
logs.fromHelp: The first day to show (Kenya time).
logs.toHelp: The last day to show (Kenya time).
logs.errorTitle: We could not load the delivery logs
logs.emptyBody: Try another channel, result or date.

correct.title: What should the priority of “{{title}}” be?
correct.body: Your answer is saved to teach the future model. It does not resend the alert.

spam.title: Spam review
spam.intro: Alerts we stopped because they looked like spam or fraud. Nobody has seen them. Decide for each one.
spam.releaseBody: It will be sent now. Choose how important it is.
spam.errorTitle: We could not load the spam review
spam.emptyBody: When an alert looks like spam, it waits here for you.

announce.title: Announcements
announce.intro: Send news to everyone, or only to workers or employers. It arrives in the app, usually as “For later”.
announce.titleHelp: Short and clear, for example “New: choose how we contact you”.
announce.confirmBody: It cannot be taken back once it is sent.
announce.sent: Sent. It is on its way.

models.title: Model versions
models.intro: The classifiers that decide how urgent each alert is and whether it is spam. One is in use at a time.
models.fallbackHelp: The ML service was slow or down, so the built-in rules answered.
models.noMetrics: No test scores yet. They are added when a model is trained.
models.errorTitle: We could not load the model versions
models.emptyBody: The first one appears when the first alert is classified.

export.title: Training data
export.body: Download every alert as a spreadsheet (CSV) for training models. Names, phone numbers and emails are removed, and people get random codes that change with every download.
export.fromHelp: Leave empty to start at the beginning.

priorityHelp.urgent: Cannot wait: sent by WhatsApp or SMS at once.
priorityHelp.medium: Worth knowing today: in the app and by email.
priorityHelp.low: Can wait: in the app and in the daily summary.
